rv.q: It was put across, sometimes sensationally, by a supremely versatile cast.
Porgy and Bess is a majestic piece of work, to say the least.
The acres of music were brilliantly served.
This production is undoubtedly one of the best offerings the Metropolitan Opera has put forward in years.
Kwamé Ryan led a perfectly paced performance that crackled with energy and churned with emotion.
This was, truly, going out at the top.

cn.t: The Met's revival of Gershwin's American masterwork earns strong praise for its powerful orchestral performances and stunning cast. Robinson's now-classic production continues to captivate audiences with its masterful execution.
